item.text: The wrappers currently discard any `fields` argument, and the Postgres field helpers build projections directly from the requested list, so an empty list does not produce full objects there. Mongo and Redis already have much of the projection behavior, including requested-but-missing fields as `null`; I’m checking their edge cases and the database test setup before applying a consistent fix.

item.text: The backend wrappers now accept `fields`, and all three helper paths treat an empty or omitted list as “return the full object.” Postgres keeps input order through its ordinal query; its selected-field SQL already emits `null` for absent fields. I’m running the existing hash database tests now and will address any compatibility issue they expose.
